title: I Should Have: Regrets and Reproaches
goal: Say what you or someone else should have done with debería haber and tendría que haber, and name a regret with me arrepiento de.
grammar: Regrets and reproaches about the past

items: I can say what I or someone else should have done with debería haber and tendría que haber.
I can name a regret with me arrepiento de.
I can use the new words for regret and blame.
